name: Therapy for Black Men
description: Directory and community connecting Black men with culturally competent mental health resources and support.

sections.title: About Therapy for Black Men
sections.text: Therapy for Black Men is an organization dedicated to connecting Black men with culturally competent mental health resources and support. The platform addresses the unique barriers Black men face in accessing mental health care, including cultural stigma around seeking help, lack of Black male therapists, and historical mistrust of healthcare systems. By providing a therapist directory, educational resources, and community support, Therapy for Black Men works to normalize mental health care and make it accessible.

sections.title: Finding a Therapist
sections.text: The Therapy for Black Men directory helps Black men find therapists who understand their experiences. Providers listed understand the unique mental health challenges facing Black men including racial trauma, microaggressions, pressures around masculinity, and systemic inequities. The directory includes Black male therapists and therapists of all backgrounds who specialize in working with Black men. You can search by location, specialty, and insurance to find a provider who fits your needs and preferences.

sections.title: Breaking Down Barriers
sections.text: Black men face significant barriers to mental health care including stigma within the community that views seeking help as weakness, messaging that men should be strong and not show vulnerability, historical and ongoing discrimination in healthcare settings, and lack of Black male representation among mental health providers. Therapy for Black Men addresses these barriers by normalizing mental health discussions, providing education, and creating spaces where Black men can openly discuss their experiences.

sections.title: Mental Health Resources
sections.text: Therapy for Black Men provides articles and resources that address mental health issues relevant to Black men's experiences. Topics include managing stress and anxiety, dealing with racial trauma, understanding depression, navigating relationships, and building healthy coping strategies. Resources acknowledge the intersection of race, gender, and mental health, and provide culturally relevant guidance for Black men at any stage of their mental health journey.

sections.title: Community and Support
sections.text: Therapy for Black Men fosters community among Black men seeking mental health support. By sharing stories and providing platforms for discussion, the organization helps Black men feel less alone in their struggles. The community challenges harmful stereotypes about Black masculinity and emotional expression, creating space for authentic vulnerability and healing. Through this community approach, Therapy for Black Men is changing the narrative around Black men and mental health.
